title: GPT Image returns, and audio gets more room
summary:
GPT Image returned, audio got larger inputs, and Enter’s FAQ and API key descriptions became more useful.

`gptimage` was re-enabled for seed-tier text-to-image generation and image editing, with images limited to 1024 pixels on the longest side. `openai-audio` now accepts up to 10,000 input characters and 6,384 completion tokens. `openai-reasoning` moved to a new Azure configuration.

Enter’s Pollen FAQ moved to markdown and was added to the sign-in page. It now clarifies daily grant timing, model access, wallets, and Quests; a follow-up fixed missing bullet markers and improved spacing in longer answers.

Descriptions entered when creating API keys now save in the expected metadata field and appear in the key table. Keys without descriptions still show a placeholder.

highlights.title: GPT Image returns
highlights.text: Seed-tier users can generate and edit images with `gptimage`, up to 1024 pixels on the longest side. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=gptimage).

highlights.title: More room for audio
highlights.text: `openai-audio` now accepts up to 10,000 input characters and 6,384 completion tokens. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=openai-audio).
